hero.description: Race to fulfill orders and cram items into limited luggage space and weight in this competitive grid coverage app-integrated board game.

hybrid.title: Combining Tabletop Experience with iOS Technology
tabletopPoints: Move meeple across the board to visit stores
Claim limited item cards from the stores
iosPoints: Scan item cards and instantly drop them into your digital suitcase
Organize and cram items into your luggage, carefully managing weight and spatial constraints
Request extra Jastip orders to score bonus points

features.title: Packing Grid
features.description: Rotate, squeeze, and Tetris-pack odd-shaped souvenirs—from fragile ramen bowls to bulky sneaker boxes—into your suitcase grid without breaking weight limits.

features.title: Multiplayer
features.description: Pass-and-play around one iPhone or sync phones at the table. Outbid rival travelers for limited drops and race the boarding gate bell together.

features.title: Jastip Orders
features.description: Your group chat never sleeps! Accept wild 'titipan' requests from picky friends—deliver on time for huge tips, or pay heavy embarrassment penalties.

howToPlay.title: Claim Jastip Orders
howToPlay.description: Draw friend request cards and inspect live demand on the iOS app. Pick risky high-tip orders or safe pocket-sized snacks.

howToPlay.title: Roll, Shop & Sabotage
howToPlay.description: Roll dice across city districts on the physical board to grab souvenirs before rival players snatch the last limited drop.

howToPlay.title: Pack Your Grid Fast
howToPlay.description: Flip to your iPhone and fit every physical item tile into your 6×6 suitcase grid before the boarding gate timer hits zero.

howToPlay.title: Clear Customs & Cash In
howToPlay.description: Survive random customs inspections, deliver completed Jastip orders, and crown the sharpest traveler at the table!

previews.title: Suitcase Packing Grid
previews.subtitle: Drag, rotate & snap souvenirs
previews.caption: Test your spatial puzzle skills in real time. Tap items to rotate 90° and balance fragile souvenirs before boarding.

previews.title: Live Jastip Orders
previews.subtitle: Urgent friend requests
previews.caption: Prioritize viral matcha snacks, limited sneakers, and skincare drops—each with unique grid shapes and tip multipliers.

previews.title: Tabletop Match Sync
previews.subtitle: Seamless party scoring
previews.caption: Keep everyone at the physical table synced on turns, boarding gate countdowns, and end-of-trip payouts.

footer.description: A flat, hand-crafted hybrid tabletop and iOS party board game inspired by the chaos of buying souvenirs for everyone back home.
